rv.q: This visually rich, wonderfully paced, aurally thrilling production keeps us wide-eyed and on tenterhooks for more than two hours.

That can't stop the play from being a noteworthy achievement this season, and one that's more than welcome on Broadway, but it's difficult not to wish that Frozen wouldn't warm up to itself - and us - just a little bit more.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Play

aw.sub: Won Best Featured Actor in a Play

cn.t: Critics praise this visually stunning production for its eye-popping stagecraft and strong ensemble performances, calling it a wonderfully paced, aurally thrilling spectacle that captivates audiences despite a familiar story.

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
